# Official PawnIO LpcACPIEC module

This directory contains **only** the official signed `LpcACPIEC` module from
[PawnIO.Modules](https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Modules).

It is **not** a kernel driver. The signed PawnIO driver must be installed
separately from https://pawnio.eu/.

PawnIO driver verifies module signatures and will reject unofficial blobs.
